content.comment_body: Hello everyone. Is it possible to connect two operator panels ([product_name]) to a single [product_name] controller? We want to have panels on both sides of the machine for operator access. Thank you in advance.
It is technically possible, but you won't have fully reliable functionality.
Could you clarify the specific limitations when using two panels with one controller? Would moving to a [version_no] control system and two basic panels be a better solution?
Some users have tried using two [product_name] panels with one [product_name] controller but encountered issues. For a definitive answer, consider submitting a support request.

Officially, only one [product_name] panel can be connected to a single [product_name] controller. If two panels are required, it's advised to use two controllers. You may configure both panels with the same controller, but this is done at your own risk.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on whether two operator panels can be connected to a single controller to provide flexibility for machine operation. While technical connection is possible, it isn't officially supported and may lead to reliability issues. Official guidance confirms support for only one panel per controller, and using more may require additional hardware or risk unsupported operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to reliably connect and operate two operator panels with one controller, enabling machine control from multiple locations without any loss of functionality. They seek official support or a reliable solution to achieve this setup.
